title: Complete, reopen and delete tasks from the list
description:
Source of truth: docs/thoughts/2026-09-17-increment-01-task-basics.md → 'On screen → / the task list' (checkbox accessible names, Done section with reopen, Delete buttons) and 'Definitions of done → Epic 2'. The list page, addTask action, components and how/tasks.md exist from the previous tick in this chain: read them.

Deliver:
- src/app/actions.ts: add `toggleTask(formData: FormData): Promise<void>` reading `id` (number) and `done` ("true"/"false") from the form data, calling setDone(getDb(), id, done === "true") then revalidatePath("/"); and `removeTask(formData: FormData): Promise<void>` reading `id`, calling deleteTask then revalidatePath("/"). Invalid or unknown ids are ignored silently (no throw), the page simply re-renders.
- src/app/components/task-list.tsx: each open row gets a form with hidden inputs id and done="true" and a checkbox `aria-label="Mark done: <title>"` that submits its form on change (a tiny client component `TaskCheckbox` with "use client" that calls `event.currentTarget.form?.requestSubmit()`), plus a Delete button in its own form (`aria-label="Delete: <title>"`, hidden input id, formAction={removeTask}). Each done row: checked checkbox `aria-label="Reopen: <title>"` submitting done="false", struck-through title, Delete button.
- e2e/tasks.spec.ts: add, after the existing tests, "marks a task done and moves it under Done (1) struck through", "reopens a done task", "deletes a task and returns to the empty state" — chained on the same 'Buy milk' task in serial mode; assert `Open (0)`/`Done (1)` headings and that the done title has the line-through class or is inside the Done section (use `page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Done (1)" })` and locator chaining).
- Docs: extend docs/current/how/tasks.md: the key-entry-points table gains toggleTask, removeTask, TaskCheckbox; the mechanism section documents the hidden-input form pattern and the accessible names exactly ("Mark done: <title>", "Reopen: <title>", "Delete: <title>"); update the Mermaid block only if the flow shape changed (it does not: same action pipeline; you may add one line for toggle/remove reaching setDone/deleteTask). Refresh the last-update line in _overview.md.
Files likely touched: src/app/actions.ts, src/app/components/task-list.tsx, src/app/components/task-checkbox.tsx (new), e2e/tasks.spec.ts, docs/current/how/tasks.md, docs/current/_overview.md.
Run in-worktree: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm docs:check
acceptance_criteria: In-worktree gates pass. Post-merge: pnpm test:e2e passes the six tasks.spec.ts tests. Accessible names exactly as specified. how/tasks.md documents toggle and remove.
